input: Get a dental cleaning and X-rays done

gold.taskTitle: Get Dental Cleaning and X-Rays Done
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to schedule and complete a routine dental cleaning along with X-rays at a dental office.

questions.title: Do you currently have a dentist you go to?
questions.description: Find out if the user has an existing dentist or needs to find a new one.

questions.title: When did you last have a dental visit?
questions.description: Understand how long it has been since the user's last cleaning or X-rays.

questions.title: Do you have dental insurance, and is it active?
questions.description: Determine if insurance coverage exists and whether it will affect provider choice or costs.

questions.title: Is there a specific timeframe you want this done by?
questions.description: Establish urgency or any deadline the user has in mind for completing the appointment.

questions.title: Are there specific days or times that work for you?
questions.description: Identify scheduling preferences such as weekdays, weekends, mornings, or evenings.

questions.title: Do you have any dental anxiety or special concerns?
questions.description: Understand if the user has fears or specific needs that would affect provider or appointment type selection.

questions.title: What city or area should the dental office be in?
questions.description: Pinpoint the geographic location so that relevant dental offices can be identified.
